audit.why: Emerald+ 53.84% over 847 games. The packet flags this as contradicting a chart that gives Akali 5 of 7 stages, but that is a lane chart against a game win rate: Akali owns levels 1-6 and Aurelion Sol wins the game from the first item on. The two are consistent, so I left rows 0-4 alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two-layer chart disagreement. Full phases[5].side said 'Akali' and phases[6].side said 'Skill', while content win[5] and win[6] both said 'Aurelion Sol'. The page rendered two different answers for First item and 2+ items.
audit.why: The packet levelChart says Aurelion Sol for both, and both full-layer whys already describe Aurelion Sol winning those stages ('your E executes the back line of every wave', 'You are the scaling endgame'). The sides were the stale half of the row.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side both move to 'Aurelion Sol', matching win[5]/win[6]. No why rewrite needed — both already argue for the owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and spikes[3] name a 'Comet' and a 'W stun' Aurelion Sol does not have, and whys[6]/late call his ultimate global.
audit.why: The live kit is the reworked one: W is Astral Flight (a 1500-range flight, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s), the only stun is R Falling Star (120/110/100s, 1250 range), and there is no Comet. This content was written against the pre-rework Aurelion Sol.
audit.corrected: Spikes and prose rewritten around Falling Star, Breath of Light and The Skies Descend. Akali's own spikes are Twilight Shroud from 3-5 (20s at rank 1, free) and Perfect Execution at 6 (120s at rank 1, down to 60s at rank 3).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to hold everything until Akali exits Twilight Shroud. Riot's own Shroud text is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — that is targeting, and neither Aurelion Sol's black hole nor Falling Star selects a target.
audit.why: Both of his answers are ground-placed zones, so they can be dropped onto the smoke while she is still inside it. Waiting out a 20s Shroud is the mistake; placing the singularity on it is the play.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shuriken Flip's re-cast marks smoke clouds, not only champions — she can flip to her own Twilight Shroud. Nothing on the page said so.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target.' That is how she leaves your black hole and returns, and it is why zoning her out of one spot does not hold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perfect Execution's execute threshold and Assassin's Mark's auto-attack reset were both absent.
audit.why: R executes below an HP threshold, so the health bar is not the read — the number is. Assassin's Mark rings you on first spell damage and empowers her next attack, so the ring, not the ability cast, is the step-back cue.
Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and costs zero energy; Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1; Falling Star is 120s at rank 1. All three change what the player does with a given ten seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player to 'stay at max Q range only' as if that were safe. Breath of Light is 750; Shuriken Flip is 825.
audit.why: Max beam range is inside her flip range, so the advice put the player exactly where she wants him.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] ended 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain.' Akali has no heal anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds does nothing here; the itemisation slot is better spent on Zhonya's against Perfect Execution.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R — no heal flag on any slot

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Shuriken Flip's' in whys[4] as a probable wrong name — that is a FALSE POSITIVE. Shuriken Flip is Akali's real E per the kit file; I left whys[4] alone. Two data problems worth knowing: (1) the ownerKit derived flag on Astral Flight reads 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes', which contradicts Riot's own description — the W flies OVER terrain, it does not create any. I trusted the description and never wrote a terrain-creation claim; that flag is misfiring and probably misfires on every Aurelion Sol matchup. (2) The whole content layer for this champion is pre-rework: 'Comet' and 'W stun' appear again here exactly as they did in the ahri file. Unverified and therefore left alone: whether Falling Star's stun can be Flash-buffered; whether Akali's Shroud reveal timing lets her dodge the beam's individual ticks; tenacity/QSS behaviour on Falling Star. The Shroud-vs-ground-zone claim in dosFull[0] and report[5] is read directly off Riot's wording ('unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks') rather than a tested source, so I marked it Medium — if the user wants it removed it is one edit.
